purpose: Current production status of the DTB Veeqo native-kit workflow relevant to reopened Columbia kits

native_kit_workflow.preview_contract: Requires exact existing parent sellable ID/SKU and component sellable IDs/SKUs/quantities; verifies each ID and exact SKU against Veeqo and returns a BOM fingerprint.
native_kit_workflow.conversion_contract: One-shot conversion of an existing ProductVariant to a Veeqo Kit; separately feature-gated, fingerprint-bound, parent-reserved, explicit confirmation required, and no retry after uncertain outcome.
native_kit_workflow.catalog_import_scope: This kit conversion ability does not create WooCommerce products and is not a general CSV/catalog importer.

candidate_readiness: No verified Veeqo sellable IDs or bill-of-materials are available for the 48 reopened source SKUs. Exact-SKU lookups through the separate Veeqo connector returned UNAUTHORIZED. No preview or conversion was attempted with inferred IDs or quantities.
